items.q: What's the difference between a demo and a real account?
items.a: A demo account lets you try copy trading with virtual funds risk-free, while a real account reflects your actual balance. You can choose and change your account type anytime from the settings page after signing up.
Once you follow a trader, every trade they execute — opening or closing — is copied to your account automatically with the same details, the moment it happens, with no manual action from you.

items.q: Can I stop copying at any time?
items.a: Yes, you can stop copying any trader instantly, anytime, from your portfolio page, with no conditions or waiting period.

items.q: Can I copy more than one trader at the same time?
items.a: No, the system is designed so you copy only one trader at a time, to keep risk management clear. However, you can follow as many traders' performance as you like without copying them, and you'll receive their performance details by email — then pick one to actually copy. You can stop copying your current trader and copy another anytime.

items.q: What's the minimum required to start copying?
items.a: The minimum varies from one trader to another, and is shown clearly on each trader's profile before you start following.

items.q: Are there any hidden fees or commissions?
items.a: No, there are no hidden commissions or fees on copying trades or on realized profits, no matter how large.

items.q: Do I need to install a separate trading platform?
items.a: No, tracking traders' performance and copying their trades happens entirely from within the Copy Matrix dashboard, with no need to install any external app or platform.

items.q: How do I deposit or withdraw?
items.a: You can submit a deposit or withdrawal request from your portfolio page at any time, and it will be reviewed and approved by our admin team before it reflects on your balance.

termsSections.title: 1. Account and Use
termsSections.body: Users must provide accurate information when creating an account and completing identity verification (KYC), and must keep their login credentials confidential and not share them with anyone else. Using the platform for any unlawful purpose, or attempting unauthorized access to other users' accounts or data, is prohibited.

termsSections.title: 2. Copying Traders and Risk
termsSections.body: The platform lets users follow other traders and automatically copy their trades to their own account. Trading and copy trading carry the risk of capital loss, and any trader's past performance is not a guarantee of similar future results. The decision to follow or copy any trader rests entirely with the user.

termsSections.title: 3. Intellectual Property
termsSections.body: All trademarks, logos, designs, and content appearing on the platform are owned by Copy Matrix and may not be copied or reused without prior written permission.

termsSections.title: 4. Changes to the Service
termsSections.body: We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any part of the platform at any time, and to update these terms in line with the service's evolution. You are advised to review this page periodically.

termsSections.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
termsSections.body: The platform is not liable for any financial losses resulting from trading or copying decisions made by the user based on information available on the platform.

termsSections.title: 6. Contact and Support
termsSections.body: For any inquiry regarding these terms, you can contact the Copy Matrix team through the support channels available within the platform.

privacySections.title: 1. Data We Collect
privacySections.body: Basic account data (name, email, encrypted password), and when applying for identity verification: full name, national ID/identity number, and a photo of your ID document and proof of address if provided. We also collect in-platform usage data such as the traders you follow and the trades linked to your account.

privacySections.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
privacySections.body: Data is used to create and operate your account, to complete identity verification in preparation for regulatory licensing, to show you portfolio and trader performance, and to improve the platform. Verification data is never used for marketing purposes.

privacySections.title: 3. Data Storage and Protection
privacySections.body: Data is stored with a cloud database and storage provider (Supabase) using strict row-level access rules (RLS), so that no user can access another user's data or documents. Access to identity verification documents is restricted to the admin review team only.

privacySections.title: 4. Sharing Data with Third Parties
privacySections.body: Your data is never shared with any third party for marketing purposes. Data may be shared with regulatory or oversight bodies if legally required as part of licensing or compliance procedures.

privacySections.title: 5. Your Rights
privacySections.body: You can request to view the data we hold about you, or request deletion of your account and data, by contacting our support team, and your request will be responded to within a reasonable time unless this conflicts with legal or regulatory obligations.

privacySections.title: 6. Cookies
privacySections.body: The platform uses only essential cookies to maintain your login session and appearance preference (dark/light mode), and never for advertising tracking purposes.

entries.question: What is the Copy Matrix platform?
entries.answer: Copy Matrix is a platform for automatically copying trades, letting you follow traders with a verified track record and link part of your balance to them, so their trades are mirrored into your portfolio automatically. Please note this is a demo environment for demonstration and practice purposes, not a licensed financial brokerage.

entries.question: How do I start using the platform?
entries.answer: To get started, create an account from the sign-up page, then choose your account type (demo or real). After that, you can browse the "Discover Traders" page and pick who you'd like to copy based on their track record and risk level.

entries.question: How do I deposit funds into my account?
entries.answer: You can deposit funds by choosing "Deposit" from the wallet section in the side menu, then entering the amount and payment method and confirming the request. Demo account deposits are instant with virtual funds, while real account deposits go through a brief review before being approved.

entries.question: How do I withdraw my profits?
entries.answer: To withdraw, choose "Withdraw" from the side menu, enter the amount and preferred withdrawal method, and submit the request. Withdrawal requests require identity verification (KYC) to already be approved, and then go through review by our team before processing.

entries.question: How long does a withdrawal take?
entries.answer: Withdrawal requests are reviewed by our team within a short period once identity verification is confirmed complete. You can track the request status anytime from the "Transaction History" page.

entries.question: What is identity verification (KYC) and why is it required?
entries.answer: Identity verification is a security procedure to confirm you are the account's actual owner, and it's required before withdrawals or full access to real-account features. Please upload a clear ID photo from the "Identity Verification" page, and it will be reviewed as soon as possible.

entries.question: Why was my trade result different from the trader I'm copying?
entries.answer: It's normal for your trade result to differ slightly from the original trader, but a large difference (like a loss for you against a profit for them) usually comes down to a specific reason: the lot size allocated to your trade may be relatively larger compared to your capital versus the trader's own ratio to theirs, the trade may have had no stop loss set so the volatility margin widened, or a small timing gap between when they opened the trade and when it was mirrored to your account. To review your specific trade's details and find the exact reason, please contact one of our support representatives at support@copy-matrix.com, mentioning the trade number if possible.

entries.question: What is copy trading and how does it work?
entries.answer: Copy trading lets you link part of your balance to a trader you choose, so every trade that trader opens is automatically mirrored into your portfolio at the same proportion, and automatically closes when they close it. You can stop copying or adjust the allocated amount anytime from the trader's page.

entries.question: Can I copy more than one trader at the same time?
entries.answer: No, the system is designed so you copy only one trader at a time, to keep risk management clear. You can still follow as many traders' performance as you like without copying them.

entries.question: What is the minimum amount to copy a trader?
entries.answer: Each trader sets their own minimum copy amount, shown on their profile page next to the "Copy" button, and it typically ranges between $75 and $1,000 depending on the trader.

entries.question: How do I stop copying a trader?
entries.answer: Open “My copies” and press “Stop copying”. Open trades are closed and copying stops immediately.

entries.question: What does the risk level shown next to each trader mean?
entries.answer: The risk level reflects the trader's own trading style, from "conservative" with limited volatility to "high risk" with larger swings and bigger profits or losses. We recommend reviewing this rating alongside the win rate and trade history before deciding to copy.

entries.question: What do the trading reliability level and win rate mean?
entries.answer: The reliability level and win rate are indicators calculated from the trader's actual past trade record, helping you assess their historical performance. You'll find these indicators in detail on each trader's profile page.

entries.question: Are there any hidden fees or commissions?
entries.answer: There are no hidden commissions on the copying service itself. Any fees tied to deposit or withdrawal transactions, if applicable, are shown clearly right before you confirm the transaction.

entries.question: I forgot my password, what should I do?
entries.answer: Please click "Forgot your password?" on the login page, then enter your email, and you'll receive a message with a link to reset your password.

entries.question: How do I edit my personal account details?
entries.answer: You can edit your personal details from the "Settings" page, available in the side menu.

entries.question: How do I change the platform language?
entries.answer: You can change the display language from the icon at the top of the homepage next to the platform logo, and the platform will automatically open in your browser or phone's language on your first visit.

entries.question: How do I keep track of my account notifications?
entries.answer: All alerts about your account and trades reach you via the bell icon at the top of the page, and you can review the full history at any time.

entries.question: Is there a mobile app?
entries.answer: The platform currently runs through the browser with a responsive design that fully supports mobile phones and tablets.

entries.question: Are my money and data safe?
entries.answer: Your data is handled with complete confidentiality and stored encrypted, and any change to your balance or account is recorded in a complete internal audit log. For more details, please review the Privacy Policy.

entries.question: What's the difference between a demo and a real account?
entries.answer: A demo account lets you try copy trading with virtual funds with no actual risk, while a real account is based on your actual balance, and reflects real copying results in profit or loss.

entries.question: How do I suspend or delete my account?
entries.answer: To suspend or delete your account, please contact our support team at support@copy-matrix.com explaining the reason, and you'll be guided through the necessary steps.

entries.question: How do I reach the human support team?
entries.answer: We're happy to hear from you anytime at support@copy-matrix.com, and our team will respond to your inquiries as soon as possible.

smallTalk.question: Greeting
smallTalk.answer: Welcome to Copy Matrix! We're happy to help — how can we assist you today?

smallTalk.question: Thanks
smallTalk.answer: You're welcome, we're always happy to help. Feel free to reach out if you need anything else.

About.title: About us
About.intro: Copy Matrix is a global platform for copying traders' trades across 4 markets: crypto, forex, gold and indices.

sections.title: Our vision
sections.body: We believe copy trading should be clear to everyone: verifiable performance, disclosed risk, and full control in your hands. Our goal is to help you pick who to copy based on a real track record, not promises.

sections.title: How the platform works
sections.body: You sign up with your email and start with a free demo account, then compare traders' performance and risk, choose a trader and set the amount you want to copy them with. The trader's trades are copied to your account automatically, sized in proportion to that amount, and you can stop copying instantly at any time.

sections.title: Our commitment to transparency
sections.body: Every trader has a trade history you can review before copying, and there are no subscription fees or hidden commissions. Withdrawal requests are reviewed before they are processed, and every copy has an automatic loss limit that stops it once reached.

sections.title: Risk warning
sections.body: Copy Matrix is a software platform for copying trading signals — not a financial institution, a bank, or a licensed brokerage. Trading and copy trading carry a high level of risk and may result in the loss of part or all of your capital; past performance does not guarantee future results.
